# LibreOffice Calc GUI Interface Description

## Window and Title Bar
- **Application Name**: LibreOffice Calc
- **File Name**: TaxReturn.xlsx
- **Date and Time**: Oct 22 22:50
- **Window Controls**: Minimize, Maximize, Close buttons on the top-right corner
- **System Tray Icons**: Located on the top-right, including notification bell icon
- **Desktop Environment**: Activities menu visible on the top-left

## Menu Bar
- **Menu Options**: File, Edit, View, Insert, Format, Styles, Sheet, Data, Tools, Window, Help

## Toolbar
- **Standard Toolbar Icons**: 
  - New document
  - Open document
  - Save document
  - Print document
  - Cut, Copy, Paste
  - Font color, Bold, Italic, Underline
  - Alignment tools
  - Borders
  - Fill color
  - Font size dropdown (16 pt)
  - Font family dropdown (Cambria)
  - Formula bar with cell reference A1:C1 and formula input field
  - Function buttons (Σ for sum, etc.)
  - Chart, Pivot Table, Conditional Formatting, Data Validation, etc.

## Formula Bar
- **Cell Reference**: A1:C1
- **Formula Input Field**: Contains text "Corporate Tax Return - 2024"
- **Formula Bar Display**: Shows the current cell selection and formula input

## Worksheet Area
- **Grid Layout**: Rows and columns with visible row numbers (1 to 40) and column letters (A to R)
- **Selected Area**: A1:C1 (highlighted in orange)
- **Worksheet Content**:
  - **Title**: "Corporate Tax Return - 2024" in cell A1, spanning A1:C1
  - **Revenues Section**:
    - Row 3: "Product Sales" with value "$1,200,000" in cell B4
    - Row 4: "Service Revenue" with value "$450,000" in cell B5
    - Row 5: "Investment Income" with value "$50,000" in cell B6
    - Row 6: "Other Income" with value "$15,000" in cell B7
    - Row 7: "Total Revenue" with value "$1,715,000" in cell B8
  - **Expenses Section**:
    - Row 10: "Expenses" as a heading
    - Row 11: "COGS" with value "$600,000" in cell B11
    - Row 12: "Salaries" with value "$400,000" in cell B12
    - Row 13: "Rent" with value "$120,000" in cell B13
    - Row 14: "Marketing" with value "$80,000" in cell B14
    - Row 15: "R&D" with value "$150,000" in cell B15
    - Row 16: "Depreciation" with value "$50,000" in cell B16
    - Row 17: "Travel" with value "$20,000" in cell B17
    - Row 18: "Utilities" with value "$30,000" in cell B18
    - Row 19: "Other Expenses" with value "$15,000" in cell B19
    - Row 20: "Total Expenses" with value "$1,465,000" in cell B20
  - **Tax Calculation Section**:
    - Row 22: "Taxable Income" with value "250000" in cell B22
    - Row 23: "Tax Rate" with value "21.00%" in cell B23
    - Row 24: "Tax Liability" with value "52500" in cell B24

## Sidebar (Right Panel)
- **Icons**:
  - **Format Painter**: Copy formatting from one cell to another
  - **Styles**: Apply or modify cell styles
  - **Chart**: Insert charts
  - **Function Wizard**: Access function library
  - **Formula Bar**: Show formula input field

## Status Bar
- **Sheet Information**: "Sheet 1 of 1"
- **Selection Information**: "Selected: 1 row, 3 columns"
- **Page Style**: "PageStyle_TaxReturn"
- **Language**: "English
